label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 094 ]

blocks.text: Research was done to examine the difference in taste between bread with standard and reduced slat content. Three types of bread were prepared, the same in all respects except for salt content. One loaf contained the usual amount, one loaf 10% less, one 20% less. Sixty people were asked if they could tell any difference in taste. They had to guess which loaf contains the usual amount of salt, 10% less, or 20% less. The result showed that only 30% of the guesses were correct, which is not different from what would be expected by chance.
The taste of bread is not necessarily dependent upon the salt content in the bread.

readingSentences.english: Research was done to examine the difference in taste between bread with standard and reduced slat content.
readingSentences.korean: 보통의 소금 양과 덜 들어간 소금의 양을 한 빵 간의 맛에 있어 차이를 조사하기 위한 연구가 행해졌다.

readingSentences.english: Three types of bread were prepared, the same in all respects except for salt content.
readingSentences.korean: 세 종류의 빵이 준비되어졌는데, 소금의 내용물을 제외하고는 모든 면에 있어서 같은 것이었다.

readingSentences.english: One loaf contained the usual amount, one loaf 10% less, one 20% less.
readingSentences.korean: 한 덩어리는 보통의 양을 포함했고, 하나는 10%를 덜 포함했고, 하나는 20%를 덜 포함했다.

readingSentences.english: Sixty people were asked if they could tell any difference in taste.
readingSentences.korean: 60 명이 그들이 맛에 있어 어떤 차이를 구별할 수 있는지를 질문 받았다.

readingSentences.english: They had to guess which loaf contains the usual amount of salt, 10% less, or 20% less.
readingSentences.korean: 그들은 어떤 빵이 보통 양의 소금을, 10% 덜, 20% 덜 포함하고 있는지를 추측해야 했다.

readingSentences.english: The result showed that only 30% of the guesses were correct, which is not different from what would be expected by chance.
readingSentences.korean: 그 결과는 추측의 30%만이 맞다는 결과를 보여 줬는데, 이는 우연히 예상됐던 것과 같은 것이었다.

readingSentences.english: The taste of bread is not necessarily dependent upon the salt content in the bread.
readingSentences.korean: 빵의 맛은 반드시 빵에 포함된 소금의 양에 달린 것이 아니다.
